1. About GBELS

GBELS (Government Boys Elementary Lower School management system) is a complete, offline-first school administration app built specifically for GBELS Gehal Pur, Taluka Digri, District Mirpurkhas (SEMIS: 405010241). It runs entirely inside a single HTML file — there is no internet connection, server, or app-store install required.

Everything the app needs — student and staff records, attendance, fees, results, certificates, settings, even embedded photos and signatures — is stored on the device itself, using the browser's IndexedDB storage. This means the school's data stays fully private and fully usable even with no internet or mobile signal, which matters for a rural campus.

The interface works in three languages — English, Urdu and Sindhi — and every printable report, certificate, ID card and WhatsApp message can be generated bilingually where relevant.

Tip: Because the app is one self-contained HTML file, always keep the latest exported build and a recent backup (see Section 34) somewhere safe — a Google Drive folder, a USB drive, or emailed to yourself. If the phone is lost or reset, the file plus a backup is everything needed to be back up and running.
2. Getting Started
2.1 Opening the App

Open the GBELS HTML file in Chrome (Android) or any modern browser. The app loads instantly since nothing needs to be downloaded from the internet.

2.2 Creating a Home Screen Shortcut (Android)

For quick daily access without hunting through the Downloads folder:

  • Open the GBELS HTML file once in Chrome so it's in your recent files/downloads.
  • Tap the ⋮ menu in Chrome → "Add to Home screen".
  • Confirm the name (e.g. "GBELS") and tap Add — this creates an icon on the home screen that opens the file directly, just like a regular app.
2.3 First-Time Setup
  • Go to Settings → School Setup and confirm the school name, address, SEMIS code, and admin details are correct.
  • Set a PIN under Settings → PIN Protection if the device is shared or the data is sensitive (see Section 35.1).
  • Add staff members first (Staff tab) so their names are available for signatures and sign-offs on printed reports.
  • Add students, either one at a time (Add Student tab) or in bulk via CSV/Excel import.
3. App-Wide Controls (Header Bar)

These controls sit at the very top of the app and are available from every tab.

  • 🔍 Global Student Search — type a name, GR number, or father/guardian name and jump straight to that student's profile from anywhere in the app.
  • 🔍 Global Staff Search — type a name, staff ID, CNIC, designation, or contact number and jump straight to that staff member's profile from anywhere in the app.
  • 🔍 Global Report Search — type any feature or report name to jump straight to it, without hunting through the tab menu.
  • 🔒 Lock — instantly locks the app behind the PIN screen. Use this before handing the device to someone else.
  • 🌙 Dark Mode — toggles a dark colour scheme, easier on the eyes in low light.
  • 🔆 High Contrast — boosts text/background contrast across the whole app for better readability.
  • 🔤 Font Size — cycles between Original, Small, Medium and Large text sizes app-wide.
  • 🔍 Contrast Check — scans the current screen and flags any hard-to-read, low-contrast text, grouped table/section-wise (e.g. which tab, which report, which column) so a flagged issue is easy to locate, worst section first. Results can be downloaded as JPG or PDF to send along with a fix request.
  • 🎨 Theme Quick Select — instantly switches the app's colour palette (30 built-in themes — Original plus 29 colour options). The 🎨 Themes button opens fuller theme settings.
  • 🌐 Language Toggle — cycles the interface language (English / Urdu / Sindhi).
  • ⬌ Menu layout — switches the left-hand tab menu between vertical and horizontal layouts.
4. Notify & Alerts

This is the tab that opens by default when the app launches — everything that needs the Head Master's attention today, in one place.

  • ☀️ Morning Briefing — nine tap-to-expand tiles: Birthdays Today, 🎉 Staff Birthdays Today, 🔴 Students Absent Today, Staff on Leave Today, Leave Quota Warnings, Staff Attendance Not Marked, 🙋 Classes Attendance Not Marked (which classes haven't had any attendance marked yet for today — excludes Sundays/Holidays), 📄 Warning Letters Awaiting Follow-up (an open Redress case whose most recent Warning Letter is older than the response window that letter itself quoted — 14 days for Tier 1, 7 for Tier 2, 3 for Tier 3), and 📦 Low Stock / Inventory Alert (items from the Stock Consumption Log at or below their reorder threshold, or negative). Tapping a tile expands its list inline; tapping it again collapses it. Staff birthdays are read from the new 🎂 Date of Birth field on the Staff Management Add/Edit form.
  • 📤 Share Today's Summary — builds a single printable "Daily Digest" out of everything currently flagged (absentees split by repeat-absence streak, students below 75% attendance this month, staff on leave, leave quota warnings, unmarked staff attendance, classes with attendance not marked, and low-stock / inventory items at or below their reorder level) for HM record-keeping; can be printed, saved as PDF, or shared via WhatsApp. Birthdays are left out of this digest since they already have their own reminder below.
  • 🔔 Tomorrow Holiday Notice — auto-appears the day before a holiday.
  • 🎂 Birthday Reminder — today's and this week's/month's student birthdays.
  • ⚠️ Low Attendance Warning — flags students whose attendance has dropped below the school's threshold.
  • 📚 Overdue Homework — Not Graded Yet — flags any assignment whose due date has passed with grading never started, so a missed batch doesn't sit unnoticed.
5. Dashboard

The Dashboard is the home screen and gives a bird's-eye view of the whole school.

  • 📈 Year-wise Comparison Report — compares enrolment, results, and other key numbers across academic years.
  • ⚠️ Smart Alerts & Flags — a live summary pulled from Smart Flags (missing data, low attendance, overage/underage students, etc.) so problems surface without having to visit that tab. The widget itself has its own 🖨️ PDF/Share, 📥 CSV, and Excel buttons to export the current alerts list exactly as filtered on screen.
  • 📋 Document Completeness Scorecard — tap "📋 Doc Scorecard" next to the alerts export buttons to see, per student, which key documents/fields (Photo, B-Form, DOB, Admission Date, Mobile No., WhatsApp No.) are on file and which are missing, with a completeness score, class filter, and an "Incomplete only" toggle — then 🖨️ PDF/Share the scorecard.
  • 📡 Live Register — Today — a snapshot of today's attendance as it's being marked.
  • 🚩 At-Risk Students & Redress — students flagged for chronic low attendance or low marks, with a "Scan Attendance for At-Risk Students" action and the ability to "Escalate Systemic Issue" for follow-up. A summary table at the top of the box (Student / Tier / Letter sent / Deadline / Today / Status) shows every open case's follow-up status at a glance. Each case card can issue a tier-based 📄 Warning Letter (Print, WhatsApp, or SMS) and Advance Tier as a situation escalates — see the Warning Letters & Follow-up note below.
  • 📄 Warning Letters & Follow-up (part of At-Risk Students & Redress) — tap 📄 Warning Letter on a case card to generate a bilingual (English + Urdu, with Sindhi support) tier-based letter: Tier 1 "Attendance Notice", Tier 2 "Attendance Warning Letter" (7-day response window), Tier 3 "Final Warning Notice" (3-day window). Choose 🖨️ Generate & Print, 🟢 Send via WhatsApp, or 💬 Send via SMS — each is logged separately in the case's action history with a timestamp. Tap Advance Tier to move the case up (it cycles 1→2→3→1… so it can be adjusted as a situation changes). Once a letter is on file, the case card shows a follow-up due date ("📅 Follow-up due by…" or, once passed, "⚠️ Follow-up overdue…"), and an open case whose letter has gone past its response window without action also surfaces in the ☀️ Morning Briefing's "Warning Letters Awaiting Follow-up" tile. Past letters can be reviewed (View) or removed from the case log from the action history.
  • 📊 Class-Wise Student Count Summary — a Muslim/Non-Muslim, Boys/Girls breakdown by class, exportable as PDF/Excel/CSV and shareable directly to WhatsApp as an image (see the earlier fix to this button's WhatsApp logo).
  • 📐 Student–Teacher Ratio (STR) Analysis — calculates and displays the school's STR, per-class breakdown, with 📥 Export CSV, Excel, and 🖨️ Print/Share.
  • 🎂 Age-Wise Class Breakdown — count of students per exact age (5, 6, 7…) within each class, based on Date of Birth, with a "📅 Age Wise Horizon" / "🏫 Class Wise Horizon" toggle, plus 🖨️ Print/Share and 📥 Export CSV/Excel for whichever layout is showing.
  • 👦👧 Gender-Wise Age Breakdown — the same age breakdown split further into Boys/Girls/Total per age, with an "📅 Age Wise Horizon" / "🏫 Class Wise Horizon" toggle to switch which axis runs across the top, plus 🖨️ Print/Share and 📥 Export CSV for whichever layout is showing.
  • One-tap official exports: 📄 Annual Report PDF, 🏛️ SEMIS Census Export, 🏛️ EMIS Auto-Fill Helper, 📋 Census Report (PDF/Excel/CSV), and 🏫 School Profile (PDF) — built for handing straight to the education department.
6. Smart Flags (Data Quality Dashboard)

Smart Flags automatically scans every student record for common data problems and academic risk signs, so issues get caught early instead of at exam time or during a SEMIS audit.

  • 🏫 Class Overview — a per-class summary card grid (Total/Male/Female/Muslim/Non-Muslim/Duplicate GR/Missing Data/Complete counts); tap a class card to expand its student-level table inline. Exportable as its own 🖨️ Print/PDF, 📥 CSV, and Excel report, separate from the individual flag categories below.
  • 📋 Students with Missing Data — a dedicated table of every student missing one or more key fields (DOB, Admission Date, etc.), with inline quick-edit fields to fill gaps right from the list. Has its own 🖨️ Print/PDF, 📥 CSV, and Excel export, and can be hidden/shown as a section if not needed.
  • 🔴 Low Marks / 🟡 No Marks — students missing or failing recent results.
  • 🔵 Overage / 🟣 Underage — students outside the expected age range for their class.
  • 📵 No WhatsApp No. / 📅 Missing DOB — incomplete contact or personal data.
  • 📵 No Mobile No. — students with no mobile number entered at all, so a parent can't be reached by call or SMS (separate from the WhatsApp check above).
  • ⚠️ Duplicate GR — same as in Section 12 (All Students), surfaced here too.
  • 🎂 Birthdays — upcoming student birthdays.
  • 🔴 Low Attendance — students falling below an acceptable attendance threshold.
  • 📉 Attendance Trend — catches attendance that is sliding before it turns chronic: each student's last 30 school days are compared with the 30 school days before that, and a drop of 15 or more percentage points is flagged while the student is still above the Low Attendance line (needs at least 5 marked days in each window). Non-critical early warning — a heads-up, not a parent notice.

Each flag category can be filtered with "🚩 Issues Only", selected in bulk, exported (🖨️ PDF / 📥 CSV / Excel), or dismissed ("✕ Clear" with an "↩️ Restore Cleared" undo). See also the Smart Flags dashboard (Duplicate GR/B-Form, missing DOB/Admission No./Father Name, unreachable contacts) for the record-level data-quality view.

7. Reports (Students Report Builder)

The most flexible reporting tool in the app — build a report from scratch instead of using a fixed template.

  • 📊 Students Report Builder — pick exactly which student fields to include (tick individual checkboxes, or ☑️ Select All Fields / ⬜ Clear Fields), apply filters (class, gender, religion, etc.), then ⚙️ Generate Report.
  • 👤 Staff Report Builder — the same idea, applied to staff records instead of students.
  • 🎂 Age-Wise Class Breakdown Report — same count-per-exact-age table as the Dashboard widget, with its own "📅 Age Wise Horizon" / "🏫 Class Wise Horizon" toggle, filterable by one or more classes via the 🏫 All Classes tick-box picker, by one or more ages via the 🎂 All Ages tick-box picker, and by a ⚧ Gender dropdown (All/Male/Female), with ⚙️ Generate, 🖨️ Print, and 📥 Export CSV/Excel for whichever layout is showing.
  • 👦👧 Gender-Wise Age Breakdown — same Boys/Girls/Total-per-age table as the Dashboard widget, with its own "📅 Age Wise Horizon" / "🏫 Class Wise Horizon" toggle, filterable by one or more classes via the 🏫 All Classes tick-box picker, by one or more ages via the 🎂 All Ages tick-box picker, and by a ⚧ Gender dropdown (All/Male/Female — narrows to just Boys or just Girls), with ⚙️ Generate, 🖨️ Print, and 📥 Export CSV for whichever layout is showing.
  • Every generated report can be 🖨️ Printed, exported to 📥 CSV, or shared via WhatsApp using the standard print-preview toolbar (see Section 39).
8. Add Student
  • ➕ Add New Student — a full form (name, surname, father's name, GR number, class, DOB, gender, religion, B-Form/CNIC, address, etc.). A 📷 Camera option lets you capture the student's photo directly.
  • 📱 Mobile No. / WhatsApp No. — kept as two separate fields, since a family's Mobile No. and WhatsApp No. aren't always the same number. Anywhere the app sends a WhatsApp message, it uses WhatsApp No. if filled in, and automatically falls back to Mobile No. if WhatsApp No. is left blank — so a student with only a Mobile No. on file still receives messages instead of being silently skipped.
  • 📋 Additional profile fields — Disability, Place of Birth, Address, Village, City, Medium, and Parent/Guardian details — all available on the Add Student form and editable later from the student's profile.
  • 📤 Import Students from CSV/Excel — download the CSV template first (⬇️ Download Template), fill it in Excel/Google Sheets for a whole class or the whole school, then import in one go with ✅ Import Students.
9. ID Cards
9.1 Student ID Cards

Open ID Cards to generate student ID cards with photo, name, GR number, class, and school branding. Pick a Class or search a single student, choose the language (English/Urdu/Sindhi) and verification code type (QR/Barcode/Both/None), optionally include the Head Master's and Class Teacher's digital signatures and the school logo, then use 🔍 Preview to check the layout before printing a batch, and 🖨️ Print ID Card(s) to print for one student or a whole class at once.

9.2 Staff ID Cards

The same ID Cards tab also generates ID cards for teaching and non-teaching staff, in its own Staff ID Card Generator box below the student one. Choose Staff Type (All Staff/Teaching/Non-Teaching) or search a single staff member by Personal ID, CNIC, or name, pick the language and verification code type, optionally include the Head Master's digital signature and the staff member's own saved signature (upload signatures in the Staff tab → Edit) and the school logo, then 🔍 Preview and 🖨️ Print Staff ID Card(s) the same way as student cards.

10. Attendance
  • ✅ Mark Attendance — the daily entry screen; mark each student Present/Absent/Leave, or use "Mark All Present" and adjust exceptions, then 💾 Save Attendance. The Day Type dropdown under the date sets that day as ✅ Working Day, 🟡 Holiday or ⚪ Off Day, or applies ☀️ Summer / ❄️ Winter Holidays across a date range (see Apply as Holiday below).
  • 📡 Live Register — Today (inside Mark Attendance) — running Present / Absent / Leave / Marked totals shown under the marking grid; it follows the Attendance For dropdown and refreshes the moment you switch it. Students mode breaks the totals down by Class; Staff mode breaks them down by Staff Type (Teaching / Non-Teaching), adds an Official Duty column (staff have an "O" status, students don't) and a Total row.
  • 🏖️ Attendance ↔ Leave sync (Staff and Students) — the "L" mark and the Leave tab's records are kept in step: (1) marking anyone L offers to open the Leave tab right after (Staff Leave Manager pre-filled with that teacher and date; Student Leave Manager for a student) — Cancel just keeps the L mark. (2) Changing an L to another status, or clearing it with ✖, checks whether a Leave record covers that date; if so a 🏖️ Leave Record Found popup offers 🗑️ Delete [date] from Leave Record (removes just that one day — a single-day record is deleted, a multi-day range is trimmed or split) or 🗓️ Keep Leave Record As-Is (tapping outside also keeps it). (3) After a Bulk Range → 🗑️ Clear Range, one Leave Records Found in Cleared Range summary popup lists every overlap and applies a single choice to all: 🗑️ Delete These Dates from Leave Records, or 🗓️ Keep All Leave Records As-Is. (4) Scanning the QR of someone who has a Leave record for that date pauses the scan — nothing is written until you tap ✅ Yes — Mark Present Anyway or 🚫 No — Skip This Scan, so a mis-scan can't silently overwrite a valid leave.
  • 📷 Scan QR Attendance — scans the QR code already printed on a Student or Staff ID Card and marks that person Present for the selected date instantly, no need to find them in the list first. Works for both Students and Staff (auto-detects which ID card type is expected from the current mode, and rejects a mismatched card). Requires camera access (https:// or Termux http://localhost — plain file:// pages can't use the camera).
  • 🔍 Student Lookup — pull up one student's attendance history directly.
  • 📆 Bulk Range — mark the same status across a date range in one action (e.g. a school-wide holiday).
  • 📅 Monthly Register — pick a Class and Month, tap 📅 Generate Register, then switch between three views with the buttons under it: (1) 🗓️ Attendance Register — the full month's day-by-day grid for the class, printable, with a Status column and All / Critical / Below Avg / Regular filter chips. (2) 📋 Students Summary — one row per student for the month (Present / Absent / Leave totals, % and Status, no day-by-day columns) with the same filter chips, 🖨️ Print / PDF and 📥 Export CSV. (3) 👤 Student Year View — choose the Class, search by Name or GR, pick the student and the session (April–March) to get a 12-month table: Working days, Marked, Present, Absent, Leave, % and Status, plus a whole-year total; a month where every day is a holiday shows 📅 Holidays instead of a status. It has the same filter chips, 🖨️ Print / PDF and 📥 Export CSV. Status colours (same in all three views): ✅ Regular = 75% or above, ⚠️ Below Avg = 60–74%, 🔴 Critical = below 60%; a blank "—" just means nothing has been marked yet. Exports under Generate Register: 📥 CSV (Month) and Excel (Month), plus CSV and Excel for the full academic session (every date, April–March, built from the selected month) — the full-year Excel is the practical one, since 300+ date columns are too wide for a printed page. Use with care: 🧹 Clear Register (This Class) wipes attendance and the Holiday/Off Day settings for the selected class and month, and 🗑️ Clear All Classes Register does the same for every class and every month — take a 💾 backup first.
  • 📊 Reports & Alerts / 📣 Absentee Alerts — generates attendance summary reports and highlights chronic absentees.
  • 📆 Date-Range Absent Report — inside Reports & Alerts: pick a class and a From/To date range plus a minimum absent-days count, and get a printable/exportable list of exactly which students crossed that threshold, with each one's specific absent dates and a bulk WhatsApp send option.
  • 📥 Import/Export — bring attendance data in or out in bulk.
  • 🌡️ Heatmap — a visual, colour-coded view of attendance patterns over time, exportable as CSV or Excel.
  • ☀️ Apply as Holiday / Holiday Remarks — mark specific dates as school holidays so they're excluded from attendance calculations, and add a remark (e.g. "Eid Holiday", "Flood Closure").
  • 📋 Notes Board — Calendar — a calendar for noting events, custom holidays, and reminders alongside the standard holiday list.
  • Notify Absent Parents (WhatsApp) / 💬 Notify Absent Parents (Text) — send same-day absence notices straight to parents' phones.
  • 👨‍🏫 Staff Register — a parallel attendance register for teaching and non-teaching staff, with its own reports and printing.
11. Leave

Two separate cards, matching the Leave tab itself: 🗓️ Staff Leave Record and 🎓 Student Leave Record. Leave/Absence Log and Backup/Restore JSON appear in both — Leave/Absence Log opens pre-set to the matching side (staff or student), and either Backup/Restore JSON button covers the same combined Staff + Student leave backup.

🗓️ Staff Leave Record
  • 🗓️ Staff Leave Manager — per-teacher leave records with add/delete and balance display.
  • 📊 Leave Balance — school-wide Casual/Sick/Medical/Earned leave quotas with a Used/Annual balance per staff member, printable and exportable.
  • 📅 Leave Calendar — a month view of every staff member's approved leave, colour-coded by leave type, with a day-detail popup listing who's on leave and why.
  • 🗂️ Leave/Absence Log — Staff view of the combined student/staff leave-absence record, exportable to CSV.
  • ℹ️ Leave Types, Quota & Approval Guide — an expandable reference table of leave types, yearly quotas, and approval rules, printable on its own.
🎓 Student Leave Record
  • 🎓 Student Leave Manager — per-student leave records (type/dates/reason) with add/delete, in its own card separate from Staff Leave Manager — no quota tracking, since that's a staff/HR concept.
  • 🗂️ Leave/Absence Log — the same combined log as above, opened pre-set to the Student view.

💡 Tip: the Leave and Attendance panel buttons act as toggles — tapping the button of a panel that is already open closes it and returns to whichever panel was showing before; tapping a different button opens that one instead. Marking or clearing "L" in Attendance also links back here — see Attendance ↔ Leave sync in Section 10.

12. All Students

The master list of every enrolled student, with search, class/gender/religion filters, sorting (youngest/oldest), row selection for bulk delete, and a 📸 Bulk Photo Capture mode for quickly photographing several students in a row. Exportable as a printable list, CSV, or Excel.

📸 Bulk Photo Capture

Click the 📸 Bulk Photo Capture button at the top of the All Students list to switch into photo-capture mode, where you can quickly photograph several students in a row using your device's camera. Once enabled, tap each student row to capture their photo — the app will move to the next student automatically. Tap ✕ Finish & Close when done.

  • ⚠️ Duplicate GR — automatically flags any two students that share the same GR number so you can fix data-entry mistakes, with 📥 CSV, Excel, and 🖨️ Print.
  • 🧮 Fields — next to Show List, opens a tick-box modal to choose which of the 28 available columns (the original 14, plus 14 more under "Additional Student Details" — Surname, B-Form, Address, Village, Taluka, District, City, Medium, Disability, Place of Birth, Guardian Name, Guardian CNIC, WhatsApp No., Mobile No.) appear in the on-screen student list. The choice is remembered on this device only and affects the on-screen list alone — CSV/Excel/PDF exports use their own separate column selection and are unaffected.
Student 360 Profile

A one-page printable snapshot of a single student — tap the 📊 button next to their name in the All Students list. Brings together Attendance %, Fee status, Academic Results, a Homework summary (submitted/late/pending/excused counts, average marks, and the 3 most recent assignments), and any At-Risk/Redress flags, so a full picture of the student is available without opening each of those tabs separately. Printable/shareable via the standard print-preview toolbar (see Section 39). On the Student Details card itself, 👁️ Preview opens the same full profile page in a new tab just to look it over, without triggering a download or share — 📁 Full Portfolio (PDF) next to it combines ID Card, Marksheet, Attendance, and Certificate into one PDF. Once a student has marks recorded, the same card also shows a standalone 🖨️ Print Marksheet button, for when only the result card itself is needed rather than the full portfolio.

13. Class View

Shows one class at a time in a clean roster view — useful for a class teacher checking their own students, adding remarks per student, or printing/exporting just that class.

14. Homework / Assignment Tracker

Open Homework to set class-wide assignments and track each student's submission and grade.

14.1 New Assignment

Pick the Class, then fill in Subject, Title, Date Assigned, Due Date, and (optionally) Total Marks and a Description/Instructions note. It's created for every student in that class by default — untick individual students below to exclude them, or use the 🔍 Find by name or GR box to quickly locate one student in a large class. Tap ➕ Add Assignment to save it.

14.2 Assignments List

Filter the list by Class, search by Subject/Title, or filter by Status (Upcoming/Overdue). Each row shows the due date, an Upcoming/Overdue badge, and how many students have submitted so far (e.g. "12/30"). If an assignment was narrowed down to specific students rather than the whole class, their names appear under the title. Tap ✅ Grade to open that assignment's grade sheet, or 🗑️ to delete the assignment entirely.

14.3 Grading & Submissions

Inside the grade sheet, set each student's Status (Pending/Submitted/Late/Excused — each shown in its own colour) and Marks Obtained, or tick multiple students and use the bulk toolbar's ☑️ Select All / Select None plus a bulk status dropdown to mark several at once. Tap 💾 Save All to keep the changes, then 🖨️ Print Grade Sheet, 📊 Export CSV, or Export Excel to share or archive the results.

14.4 Student Homework Report

Pick a class (optional) and one or more students to see every subject/lesson they've ever been assigned pulled together in one place, instead of opening each assignment's Grade panel separately to find their row. An optional Status filter narrows the results to just Pending, Submitted, Late, or Excused. Each student's block shows a summary line (total/submitted/late/pending/excused counts plus average marks % where marked) followed by a full table of their assignments (Subject, Title, Due Date, Status, Marks, Remarks). 🖨️ Print/PDF, 📥 Export CSV, and Export Excel cover all selected students in one file/printout.

14.5 Subject-wise Grip

Tracks how well each student is grasping a subject — a Status (Excellent/Good/Average/Weak, each shown in its own colour) plus a free-text Remark — separate from numerical Results marks. Can be entered two ways, both saving into the same underlying sheet, so either method updates the same data:

  • 📊 Class-wise entry — pick a Class and type a Subject to see every student in that class in one table. ☑️ Select All / Select None, 🚩 Select Weak Only (ticks just the students currently marked Weak), and a bulk "set status for selected" toolbar let a whole class — or just its Weak students — be updated in one action instead of one dropdown at a time. Tap 💾 Save Grip Sheet to save.
  • 🧑 Student-wise Grip Entry — pick a Class and one Student to see that one student's Status + Remarks across every subject (the 8 standard subjects plus any custom subject already saved for their class) in a single form, instead of visiting each subject's class-wide grid separately. ➕ Add Subject adds a subject not yet on the list. 💾 Save All Subjects saves; 🖨️ PDF / Share Report prints just that one student, all subjects.

📋 Saved Subject Grip Sheets lists every saved class+subject sheet in one table — one row per sheet, whether it covers a whole class or just a few students entered via Student-wise Grip Entry. Each row shows an Entries column ("N / M students") and an Excellent/Good/Average/Weak count summary, plus a Pending count for any student in the class who hasn't been given a status yet, with ✏️ Edit, 🖨️ PDF / Share, and 🗑️ Delete per sheet. Filter by Class, Subject, and/or Status: choosing a Status appends a student-level report below the summary table — exactly which students, in which class and subject, are at that status — with its own 🖨️ PDF / Share Report button. Filter by Student searches by name across every saved sheet — a dropdown appears under the box as you type, showing each match's Name, GR number, and Class so the right student can be confirmed and picked in one tap; once typed, it shows that student's own per-subject results grouped under their name. Subject-wise Grip also appears read-only on the Student 360 Profile (see Section 12).

15. 🕒 Timetable / Period Schedule

Open the Timetable tab to build and manage a weekly period-by-period class schedule, assign teachers to periods, and print timetables.

15.1 Period Configuration

Before building a timetable, set up your school's period structure once under the ⚙️ Configure Periods box. Enter the number of periods per day (typically 5–7), then for each one type a label (e.g. "Period 1", "Break", "Assembly") and start time (e.g. "09:00", "10:30"). Pick which weekdays are teaching days (Monday–Friday, or include Saturday). This configuration applies to all classes and is saved; you only need to set it once.

15.2 Class Timetable Builder

Pick a Class, and you'll see a grid — one row per period, one column per day — with two stacked cells per day: Subject (a dropdown fed by the same shared subject list as Homework/Assignment) and Teacher (pick from your staff list, or leave blank). Fill in each period's subject and teacher assignment. The app flags a ⚠️ conflict directly under each Teacher dropdown if that teacher is assigned to two different classes at the same day+period — scan the grid quickly to spot and fix these clashes. To add a subject that doesn't exist in the dropdown yet, tap ➕ Add Custom Subject (that subject then appears in Homework, Assignment, Subject-wise Grip, and everywhere else too). Tap 💾 Save Timetable to keep your changes.

15.3 Teacher's Weekly Schedule

Instead of seeing one class's grid, pick a teacher under the 👩‍🏫 Teacher's Weekly Schedule box to pull together that one teacher's periods across every class into a single printable timetable — showing which classes they teach in each period slot. Useful for printing a schedule card for the teacher, or for spotting if they're overloaded.

15.4 Printing & Signatures

Both Class Timetable and Teacher's Weekly Schedule have 🖨️ PDF / Share Class Timetable and PDF / Share Teacher Schedule buttons. Tap one to open a print preview. If your school has staff signatures on file (added in Staff Management), the app will prompt "✍️ Add Staff Signature to Print?" — select one or more teachers whose signature should appear on the printed timetable, then tap ✅ Apply. If no signatures are on file, the timetable prints immediately without prompting. Choose 🖨️ Print to send to your printer, Share to send via WhatsApp or email, or 📥 Download as PDF for your records.

💾 Backup & Restore

Timetable data (both the period configuration and all class assignments) is saved locally in your browser's database, the same way student and staff records are stored. It's included in full JSON Backup/Restore — if you switch devices or need to restore an older version of GBELS, your entire timetable comes back intact.

16. 🤝 PTM (Parent-Teacher Meeting) Scheduler

Open the PTM tab to schedule parent-teacher meetings, send WhatsApp invites to guardians, and track attendance.

16.1 Create a New PTM Record

Tap ➕ New PTM to set up a meeting. Fill in: Meeting Title (e.g. "Parent-Teacher Meeting — June 2026"), Date, Time, Venue (location), and Agenda (what will be discussed). Then choose which Classes are involved and which Teachers from your staff list will attend. The app auto-fetches every guardian from the selected classes. Tap ✅ Create PTM to save it.

16.2 Send WhatsApp Invites

Every PTM record has a 📨 Send WhatsApp Invite button. Tap it to send a bilingual (English + Urdu) message to all guardians in the selected classes at once, with the meeting details (Date, Time, Venue, Agenda, attending teachers). The message is sent one-by-one via WhatsApp (or SMS if no WhatsApp number is on file) — each parent gets an individually-sent message, not a broadcast. Track which guardians have seen and opened the message using WhatsApp's delivery/read status.

16.3 Attendance Checklist

On the PTM record, an Attendance Checklist lists every guardian invited. As parents/guardians arrive at the meeting, tick them ✅ Attended (or leave blank for No-Show). A counter at the top tracks total attendance — "15 / 32 present". This list can be reviewed later to see which families didn't attend. Tap 💾 Save Attendance to keep changes.

16.4 Attendance Sheet (Printable)

Tap 🖨️ Print Attendance Sheet to generate a formal attendance sheet for the meeting, showing the meeting details (Title, Date, Time, Venue, Classes, Teachers) followed by a table with one row per guardian (Name, Student Name, Attended). Print it for your records, share via WhatsApp, or download as PDF. If staff signatures are on file, you'll be prompted to add them to the printed sheet, the same way other reports work.

16.5 Edit & Delete PTM Records

Each PTM record on the list has an ✏️ Edit button (to change the meeting details or update the invited classes/teachers) and a 🗑️ Delete button to remove the record. If you've already sent invites, editing the meeting details does not resend — only the first time you tap "Send WhatsApp Invite" does the message go out.

💾 Backup & Restore

PTM records and attendance data are stored locally in your browser and included in full JSON Backup/Restore — when you restore, all PTM records return with their attendance status intact.

17. Exam Slips
  • 🗓️ Exam Date Sheet Setup — build a class-wise, subject-wise exam timetable.
  • 🖨️ Exam Date Sheet Generator — turns the timetable into a printable notice for the notice board.
  • ✅ Assign Roll Numbers — auto-assigns exam roll numbers per class.
  • 📝 Generate Exam Slip — produces individual Roll No. Slips / Admit Cards, printable in bulk for a whole class.
18. Bulk Import Marks

Download the marks CSV/Excel template for a class, fill it in offline, then import all rows at once — far faster than typing marks in one by one for a large class.

19. Results

View, print, and export (CSV/Excel) student results, and send individual or all result cards straight to parents via WhatsApp.

20. Merit List

Automatically ranks students by result within a class or across the school, exportable to CSV, Excel, or print.

21. Bulk Remarks

Applies one remark (Promoted, Pass, Fail, or Certificate Issued) to every student in a chosen class at once — much faster than opening each student's record individually after results are finalized.

22. Undo Promotion

If a student (or a whole class) was promoted to the next grade by mistake, this tab lets you search for them and ↩️ Re-Admit them back to their previous class, with a full 📜 Promotion History / Audit Log of every promotion ever made.

23. Certificates

Issue Certificate supports Enrollment, Admission, Leaving (SLC), Passing, Character, Transfer, and Marks certificates for both current and passed-out students.

  • 💡 Suggest Next No. — automatically proposes the next certificate number in sequence so numbering never clashes.
  • 🌐 Translate to Sindhi — machine-translates the certificate text where needed.
  • School logo can be uploaded once and reused on every certificate (⬇️ Download Logo / 🗑️ Remove Logo to manage it).
24. Certificates Log

📋 Open Certificates Log — a running record of every certificate ever issued, searchable, printable, exportable.

25. Bulk Certificates

🏅 Open Bulk Certificates — issue and print the same certificate type for an entire class or a selected group in one pass, with auto-numbering.

26. Passed Out

An archive of every student who has completed and left the school — kept separately from active records so class lists stay clean, but still fully searchable for issuing a certificate, sending a WhatsApp update, or answering an alumni enquiry years later.

27. Documents

Open Documents — upload, view, and download any file (photos, PDFs, Word/Excel, and more), stored on this device only. Tag each upload with a category, and optionally attach it to a Student or Staff profile.

  • ＋ Upload — pick a category, optionally attach the file to a Student or Staff profile, and add a label.
  • 🏷️ Manage Categories — add or edit the categories documents can be tagged with.
  • ☑ Select — tick multiple documents to 📤 Share Selected or 📄 Compile to PDF in one pass.
  • 🔍 Search by file name or by the attached staff/student name, and filter by category chip.
  • 💾 Backup JSON / 📂 Restore JSON — back up or restore the Documents library on its own, separate from the main app backup.
28. Bulk WhatsApp Messaging

A dedicated hub for sending the same message to many parents at once — open Bulk WhatsApp.

  • Ready-made templates: ⚠️ Attendance Alert, 🎉 Holiday Notice, 📝 Exam Schedule, 🏆 Result Notice, 📄 Result Card Ready, 📅 Parent Meeting, 💰 Fee Reminder — or ➕ New Template to save your own.
  • 🎯 Load Absentees — auto-pulls today's absent list as the recipient group.
  • 🎯 More Quick Filters — 🎂 Today's Birthdays, ⚠️ Below 75% Attendance (fills each child's real monthly %), and 📄 Open Warning Letter Cases (fills each case's own tier-based letter text, same as the Redress card's Warning Letter button) — one tap narrows the recipient list and loads the matching message.
  • 🚀 Send Queue (One-by-One) — opens WhatsApp chats one after another so each parent gets an individually-sent message rather than a broadcast.
  • 📋 Copy All Messages / 📥 Export CSV (with numbers) — for manual sending through other tools if needed.
  • 🗂️ WhatsApp Number Groups — organise parent numbers into groups, generate a 📷 QR Code group-invite link, export the whole group as a shareable contacts file (.vcf), and track ✅ Mark All Joined / ↺ Reset Joined.
29. Inventory / Assets
  • 🗄️ School Asset Register — a register of furniture, equipment, and other durable assets, with ➕ Add Asset.
  • 📦 Stock Consumption Log — tracks consumable supplies (stationery, cleaning materials, etc.) as they're used up, with 📤 Share Report for handing to the school committee or department.
  • 🧾 Purchase Register — logs every purchase made for the school (item, date, quantity, unit price, vendor, invoice number, notes), with "Totals by Item" and "Totals by Vendor" summaries, an optional From/To date filter for sharing a specific period, 📤 Share Report, and a ⬇️ Download (CSV) button for opening the raw data in Excel or attaching to an audit file.
30. Staff

Add every staff member with photo, CNIC, contact number, designation, 🎂 Date of Birth (feeds the Staff Birthdays Today tile on Notify & Alerts), and (where relevant) a saved signature image — that signature can then be auto-inserted as a sign-off on printed reports, slips, and notices anywhere in the app. A staff record also has a Reg ID (Registration ID) field, separate from Personal ID — both are optional plain-text identifiers, shown as the first two columns of the on-screen Staff List (Reg ID before Photo, Personal ID after). On the Staff Details card, 👁️ Preview opens the full staff profile in a new tab just to look it over, without triggering a download or share.

Father's Name and Gender are on the Add/Edit forms too (Gender is a Male/Female dropdown, default Male; it shows as a blue ♂ / pink ♀ pill). Posting details — every staff record also has optional Place of Posting (POP) (shown as Inst. Name/POP), Institution ID / SEMIS Code (Inst ID), UC (Union Council), Taluka and District. These appear on the Staff Profile card and shareable profile, as columns in the Staff List (right after SSC), in CSV/Excel export (including the "Select Columns to Export" dialog), and in the 🧮 Fields picker below. Existing staff show "—" for these until edited and saved. Staff can also be found by Reg ID in the search box.

🧮 Fields — on the Staff List, opens a tick-box modal (Sr., Reg ID, Photo, Personal ID, Employee Name, Father's Name, Gender, Staff Type, Designation, CNIC, Qualification, Date of Birth, Date of Appointment, Date of Joining, Retirement Date, Bank Name, IBAN Number, SSC, Inst. Name/POP, Inst ID, UC, Taluka, District, Contact, Classes, Students Assigned, Signature, Actions) to choose which columns show in the on-screen Staff List table — same pattern as the Students tab's Fields button. All fields are on by default. The choice is remembered on this device only and affects the on-screen list alone — CSV/Excel export and printed reports are unaffected.

31. Contacts

A combined directory of staff and students with phone numbers, filterable by Teaching/Non-Teaching staff or by student group, exportable to PDF/CSV for quick reference or for sharing with the education office.

32. Syllabus & Library

📈 Syllabus Coverage — set total chapters per class/subject once, then update chapters completed anytime (daily/weekly/monthly); percentage complete shows automatically, color-coded, for the current academic session.

📚 Sindh Textbook Library — track the school's textbook stock (Sindh Textbook Board titles) by class and subject. Can be hidden via its 🙈 Hide button if not needed.

33. Fee Management
  • 💾 Apply Fee to Class / Apply Fee Adjustment / Apply Manual Entry — set standard fees for a whole class, or adjust/override an individual student's fee.
  • 📱 Send Reminders — bulk fee reminders via WhatsApp or SMS, with ready-made tones: 🇵🇰 Urdu Formal, 🇬🇧 English Polite, ⚠️ Urgent Reminder, and a 📲 Short SMS variant, plus 🌐 Translate to Sindhi and a 👁️ Preview Messages step before sending.
  • 📊 Class-Wise Fee Collection Summary — see paid vs unpaid at a glance per class.
  • ⚠️ Total Outstanding / Arrears Report — a school-wide list of everyone with unpaid dues, exportable and printable.
  • 🖨️ Print Receipt — generate and print an individual fee receipt.
  • 📊 View Monthly Report + CSV / Share Report via WhatsApp — a month-by-month collection report that can be shared straight to a WhatsApp group (e.g. the school committee).
34. Backup & Restore

Because all data lives only on this device, backing up regularly is the single most important habit for using GBELS safely — open Backup & Restore.

  • 💾 Backup (JSON) / 📥 Download Backup File — creates a complete snapshot of every student, staff, fee, attendance, and settings record in one file.
  • Reminder options (7 din / 14 din / 30 din) nudge you to back up on a schedule.
  • 📤 Import Backup — restores the app from a previously saved backup file, e.g. after a phone reset or when moving to a new device. The import dialog warns that it will REPLACE the data currently in this file, then lets you choose exactly what to bring in — every box is ticked by default, with Select All / Deselect All buttons: ✅ Students, ✅ Staff / Teachers (photos + signatures), 🏖️ Leave, ✅ Marks, 📚 Homework & Syllabus & Library (includes the Sindh Textbook Library), ✅ Attendance, 🗓️ Timetable & PTM, ✅ Fees, ✅ Certificates Log, 📝 Bulk Remarks, ↩️ Undo Promotion, 🎓 Passed Out (unticking it leaves passed-out archive rows out of an incoming Students import), 📦 Inventory/Assets, 📁 Documents (attached files), 🗑️ Recycle Bin, ✅ Settings, 📋 Notes Board (calendar, notes, holidays) and ⚙️ Backup & Restore Settings.
  • 💾 Per-tab Backup / Export JSON — the tabs that have their own 💾 button (Timetable, PTM, Passed Out, Students, Attendance, Staff, Leave, Marks, Fees, Certificates, Homework, Exam Slips, Documents, Inventory, Contacts, Library) download a smaller file named <Tab>_JSON_GBELS_<date>.json (e.g. Students_JSON_GBELS_2026-09-15.json), so they sort together by tab name in the Downloads folder. The main app-wide backup keeps its own name, JSON_GBELS_Backup_<id>_<date>.json.
  • 🆕 Copy with New ID / Share This File / Share via WhatsApp — ways to duplicate or send the backup file off-device.
  • 🔍 Find Duplicates / 🗑️ Delete All Duplicates — cleans up accidentally duplicated records inside the data itself.
34.1 ☁️ Cloud Backup (Google Drive)
  • 🔑 Connect Google Drive — signs in with your own Google account (no GBELS server involved); only works when the app is opened over http(s) — a plain file:// open won't support it.
  • ☁️ Backup Now to Drive — uploads the current JSON backup straight to a "GBELS Backups" folder in your Drive, with a live upload progress bar.
  • 📥 Restore from Drive — lists the JSON backups saved in that Drive folder, downloads whichever one you pick, and feeds it into the same restore flow as Import Backup.
  • An Auto-Backup toggle and interval (Daily/7/14/30 din) can upload to Drive on a schedule automatically, checked about once a minute while the app tab stays open.
  • The app only asks you to sign in again on its own when Auto-Backup is ON and a backup is actually due — and at most once per day, even if that attempt fails (e.g. no internet). It will never ask just because the app was opened.
Tip: Always keep at least one backup copy off the device — in Google Drive (via Cloud Backup above, or manually), emailed to yourself, or on a USB drive — in addition to the on-device copy.
35. Settings
35.1 PIN Protection

Set a PIN to lock the app when it's not in use. Options include changing the PIN, removing it entirely, and setting a recovery email in case the PIN is forgotten.

35.2 Report Template Manager

Lists every report, export, print and share button in the app on one screen, grouped by tab in the same order as the sidebar (Notify & Alerts first, Translate last). Turn any of them off and that button disappears from its tab everywhere in the app; turn it back on any time — nothing is deleted, it only hides the button. Use the search box, ✅ Show All / 🚫 Hide All, and the All / ✅ Enabled / 🚫 Disabled chips to find things quickly. It also has widget toggles (a separate slate-coloured type, not an export) that show or hide whole dashboard items: the Morning Briefing tiles and Syllabus Coverage Overview on Notify & Alerts, the Smart Alerts & Flags filter chips and summary tiles on the Dashboard, and the Smart Flags tab's KPI cards and chart cards.

35.3 School Setup

The master record for the school's own details — name, address, Place of Posting, School Specific Budget Code (optional, e.g. BC-12345), SEMIS code, admin name/photo/contact — used automatically across every certificate, report, and printed document. "↩️ Reset All to GBELS Gehal Pur" restores the defaults for this school if anything gets changed by mistake.

35.4 Storage / Backup Health

Shows how much data is stored on the device and how recently a backup was taken, so storage problems or an overdue backup are caught before they cause data loss.

35.5 Version / Changelog

"📜 View Recent Changes" shows what's new or fixed in the current build — useful for confirming which build is currently installed.

35.6 🔔 Push Notifications for Alerts

Turns today's Notify & Alerts items (birthdays, absences, staff on leave, leave-quota warnings, staff attendance not marked, low stock, holidays, low attendance) into real phone notifications, so you don't have to keep checking the tab. Needs notification permission, and only fires while the app's tab is open somewhere (foreground or backgrounded) — a fully closed tab won't deliver notifications, since there's no server to push in the background. Each alert notifies once per day, re-checked about once a minute while the tab stays open.

36. Recycle Bin

Open Recycle Bin — deleted students, staff, or other records are held here rather than being erased immediately. ♻️ Restore Selected (or Restore All) brings them back; 🗑️ Delete Selected / Empty Recycle Bin removes them permanently. This is the safety net for accidental deletions.

37. Ask the Guide (Built-in Help Assistant)

A small offline Q&A chat box — type a plain question in everyday words and it finds the matching feature and tells you exactly how to use it. It runs fully on the device, matching only against the guide content already in the app, so it needs no internet connection and no API key.

  • 💬 Floating chat button — sits in the bottom-right corner on every tab, not just the User Guide, so a question can be asked without navigating away from what you're doing.
  • 💬 Inline chat box — the same assistant also sits directly on this User Guide tab, just above the section jump list below.
  • Type a question the way you'd ask a person — e.g. "how do I issue a certificate" or "how can I add leave" — then tap ➤ or press Enter.
  • For the most common actions, the reply is a full numbered click-by-click procedure with the exact buttons to tap; for everything else, it shows the matching guide section's own description.
  • 👉 Take me there — every reply includes this button, which jumps straight to the matching tab/section and briefly highlights it, so you don't have to find it yourself afterwards.
  • ℹ️ How to ask — tap this next to the chat header for a phrasing tip (name the feature + what you want to do) plus a set of tappable example questions covering students, attendance, staff, certificates, fees, ID cards, WhatsApp, Smart Flags, backup, recycle bin, translate, and reports. Tapping any example asks it immediately — useful if you're not sure how to word your own question.
  • ✖ Clear chat — clears the conversation shown in that chat box; the floating button and the inline box each keep their own separate conversation.
38. Translate

Open Translate — a standalone Urdu ⇄ Sindhi ⇄ English translation tool, including an on-screen Sindhi keyboard for typing names and text that don't have an easy physical-keyboard equivalent, plus ⚡ Auto-Fill All to machine-translate every current student's name into Sindhi in one pass. Results can be copied, or exported to PDF/CSV.

39. Printing, Exporting & Sharing (applies everywhere)

Almost every report, list, certificate, and slip in GBELS opens the same print-preview screen, so the same set of actions is available everywhere:

  • 🖨️ Print / Save PDF — opens the device's print dialog; choosing "Save as PDF" there produces a PDF file.
  • 📷 Download JPG — saves the report as a single image file, handy for a quick share when a PDF isn't needed.
  • Share via WhatsApp — sends the report as an image directly through the device's share sheet, straight into a WhatsApp chat, with no manual export-then-attach step.
  • ⚙️ Print Settings (gear icon) — available on every print-preview screen; lets you adjust paper size, margins, and header/footer once, and those settings then apply to every future printout.
  • A Portrait/Landscape picker appears before printing so the orientation can be confirmed or changed for that specific report.
40. Tips, Best Practices & Troubleshooting
  • Back up weekly at minimum, and always before a major bulk action (bulk import, bulk delete, bulk promotion).
  • Use the Students Report Builder instead of hunting for a matching built-in report — most one-off requests ("just girls in Class Five with phone numbers") can be built directly.
  • Check Smart Flags regularly, not just before an inspection — catching a missing DOB or duplicate GR early is far easier than fixing it after months of records have built on top of it.
  • If the app looks broken or a save silently fails, check Settings → Storage/Backup Health first — most such issues trace back to device storage being full.
  • If a printout looks wrong on paper, check the ⚙️ Print Settings gear icon in that print-preview screen before assuming it's a bug — margins/orientation are a common cause.
  • Keep at least one off-device backup copy at all times — the single biggest risk to any offline, single-device system is losing or resetting that one device.
